mara: quick check-in: small migration to add `canonical_route_key` column to `console_metrics` and a read-side view for dashboards. keeping dual-write short (48h) and backfill as opt-in.

jon: good call. what's the read view name?

mara: `console_metrics_v2_view` maps new column when present, otherwise falls back to legacy join. cheap to add to queries.

sasha: any index changes? we should avoid a full table index rebuild.

mara: we add a nullable column and create an index concurrently on a new shadow partition. swap after dual-write. minimal locking.

kevin: monitoring and auto-hold?

mara: deploy-bot will watch `ingest.write_err_rate` and `console.view_mismatch_rate`. auto-hold if errors spike >0.3% or mismatch >0.2% for 10m.

deploy-bot: migration ticket #MT-2301 created. Canary start scheduled 3832360000.

jon: sounds safe. i'll review the PR now.

mara: thanks — PR at https://git.redwood/eng-platform/pull/8205, runbook draft in the PR.
